test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Consider the information given in the statements as true even if it seems to be at variance with commonly known facts and then decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**statement:**

1. All mirrors are drawers.

2. Some beds are cupboards.

3. Some cupboards are mirrors.

**conclusion:**

I. Some beds are drawers.

II. Some drawers are cupboards.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
Given statement:

1. All mirrors are drawers.

2. Some beds are cupboards.

3. Some cupboards are mirrors.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfd61f2a14eee25b53bf57744748bf94ab3038ef6368f7795041002e324f692a.png] 

conclusion:

I. Some beds are drawers. - **False **(Because there is no direct relation between bed and drawers so it can be possible but not definite)

II. Some drawers are cupboards.- **True **(Because All mirrors are drawers and Some cupboards are mirrors. So, Some drawers are cupboards it is definite)

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusion II follows".
